A second process heats a heavy hydrocarbon fraction under thermal cracking conditions without oxygen supply. Simplified example:C₁₂H₂₆→C₈H₁₈+C₄H₈. No operating temperatures, apparatus instructions or execution task are supplied. Explain each process and place lighter-condensing and heavier fractions in the temperature gradient. Check atom balance in the cracking example, classify products as alkane/alkene and explain why neither fractionation nor a single equation guarantees a pure end product or fixed real product spectrum.
